title: GraphEdit: Possible unnecessary error output?
body:
### Tested versions

Only tested on v4.5.1.stable.official on Windows 10. 

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.5.1.stable.official

### Issue description

Whenever you call `GraphEdit.get_connection_list_from_node()` with a name that doesn't have any connections, the Debugger list receives the error `Condition "!connection_map.has(p_node)" is true. Returning: TypedArray<Dictionary>().`

The error is generated from `<C++ Source>  scene/gui/graph_edit.cpp:2598 @ _get_connection_list_from_node()`

This strikes me as unnecessary because the method still returns a usable result (an empty array) which tells you there are no connections. As far as I can tell, there's no method like `GraphEdit.has_connection_list_for_node()` that would allow you to check for connections before calling `get_connection_list_from_node()` which would be required to avoid the error.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a GraphEdit node
2. Call get_connection_list_from_node() on it with any string that doesn't match a node with connections

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[graph-edit-error-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23983578/graph-edit-error-mrp.zip)
